items.title: City of West Sacramento Parking Lot — Free Food Distribution
items.description: Free food distribution at City of West Sacramento Parking Lot (Food Distribution). Schedule: Sat from 8:30 AM. Call (530) 668-0690 to confirm before you go — distributions often end early when supplies run out, and schedules change with holidays and weather. Source: Yolo Food Bank.
items.locationName: City of West Sacramento Parking Lot
